notes.title: Now Supporting SteamVR Headsets!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41286539/4a22abaedd32d2b58da0c283c6db63b32737a7e5.png

You can now play Hockey VR using SteamVR via OpenXR! 
Other changes include:

 Performance increases for all PC headsets
 Oculus Touch controllers can also open the in-game menu with the Y button on the left controller to allow SteamVR to use the menu button.
 New setting added to allow customization of how the stick aligns to the controllers to account for the wide variety of controllers available for use with OpenXR.
 Improved audio levels mix

notes.title: One-Timer Update
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ypReBFt.gif
A new one-timer game mode has been added to the game along with some quality of life gameplay improvements! 

Change list:

Added new one timer game mode for added difficulty.
Added progress bar to visualize when and where a puck will spawn to all game modes.
Added the ability to tap the ice with the VR stick and Realstick as an input method.
Added ability to tap 3 times on the ice to spawn a puck immediately. This will allow users to adjust the speed of puck drops to suit their play style. Works with VR controllers and Realstick.
